abstract.t: Structured Field Values for HTTP (RFC 9651) give HTTP fields a common syntax, but a general parser for them is a sizable dependency for a light client that needs to read only one or two fields. This document defines Simpler Fields, a profile of Structured Fields that a client can parse with a short regular expression. Its Strings are percent-encoded, so they contain no quotes, backslashes, or field delimiters. Its serialization is canonical, and its types are fixed. Every Simpler Field value is a valid Structured Field value, so a general parser reads it unchanged.
